run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the gtest XML output unit test suite to verify test result XML generation
test_non_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest binary produces the expected non-empty XML output with failures and properties
test_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest binary with no tests produces an empty XML output document
test_timestamp_value: test that the timestamp attribute in the gtest XML output is a valid ISO datetime string
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test that applying a gtest filter flag only includes matching tests in the XML output
